title: Replace CLI session-close recap stub with real memory rollup
description: Review finding from loreweaver-1ek. CLI graceful close writes a factual stub recap and empty stateDelta, which weakens persistent campaign memory despite core memory rollup surfaces. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
acceptance_criteria: CLI close writes recap content tied to played scenes and accepted mutations; context assembly uses it in later sessions; tests prove continuity across close and resume.
notes: Implemented and pushed via PR #47 https://github.com/jbongaarts/loreweaver/pull/47. composeSessionRecap in core joins scene summaries + open-scene narration and aggregates turn_trace acceptedStateDelta; CLI gracefulClose uses it in place of the stub. Tests cover composition + cross-session continuity via assembleContext.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Coupling note: the model-backed summarization machinery built here is shared with the arc-summary upgrade tracked in loreweaver-06b (follow-up to loreweaver-e0a). e0a shipped a mechanical arc rollup in the CLI gracefulClose (play.ts rollupCampaignArc) using a recap-joined summary; once 32m lands, loreweaver-06b upgrades that to a model-authored arc summary and populates the campaign bible. loreweaver-06b depends on this issue.
